# UI audit report

Scanned 325 files. **5190 errors**, 2078 warnings.

A module is *clean* when it has 0 errors and every remaining warning has been reviewed.

## By module

| Module | Files with issues | Errors | Warnings | Clean? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Vehicle Desk (`vehicle`) | 4 | 2875 | 511 | ❌ |
| Design Tracking (`design`) | 2 | 16 | 5 | ❌ |
| Dashboards & Reports (`dashboards`) | 47 | 473 | 312 | ❌ |
| Admin, RBAC & Masters (`admin`) | 28 | 488 | 265 | ❌ |
| Login & module select (`auth`) | 2 | 69 | 14 | ❌ |
| Shared components & layout (`shared`) | 76 | 787 | 636 | ❌ |
| Task Workflow (tickets, requirements, workspaces, SLA, AMC…) (`tasks`) | 25 | 482 | 335 | ❌ |

## By rule

| Rule | Severity | Count | What | Fix |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `palette-colour` | ERROR | 4409 | Tailwind palette colour (doesn't follow the theme) | Status → StatusBadge / *-soft *-text tokens; neutrals → text-muted, bg-sunken, border-border |
| `uppercase` | WARN | 1032 | UPPERCASE text | Sentence case. Only overline labels may use the .theme-label class |
| `date-format` | WARN | 303 | Ad-hoc date formatting (mixed formats) | DateCell / DueDateCell / formatDate() from components/ui/data |
| `hex-literal` | ERROR | 251 | Hex colour literal in code (inline style, chart prop, map) | Use var(--token) or CHART_THEME / STATUS_COLOR from components/ui/charts/chartTheme |
| `text-white` | WARN | 188 | text-white (unreadable on light themes unless on a primary/danger fill) | On primary fills use text-primary-foreground; elsewhere text-foreground |
| `heavy-weight` | WARN | 173 | Extra-bold weight | font-semibold for headings, font-medium for emphasis |
| `hex-colour` | ERROR | 160 | Hard-coded hex colour class | Use a token class (bg-surface, text-muted, border-border, bg-primary …) |
| `black-white` | WARN | 147 | Pure black/white surface or text | bg-surface / bg-sunken / bg-[var(--overlay)]; text-foreground |
| `hover-move` | ERROR | 127 | Element moves on hover (jitter, blurry text) | Change colour / border / shadow on hover instead |
| `clickable-div` | WARN | 97 | Clickable <div> (not keyboard accessible) | Use <button type="button"> or <Link>; rows may be clickable if they also have a link/button inside |
| `dashed-pill` | ERROR | 72 | Dashed border (dashed status pills / boxes) | StatusBadge for statuses; FileDropzone is the only dashed element |
| `old-hover-token` | ERROR | 69 | Class that resolves to nothing | See UI_STANDARDS.md token list |
| `emoji` | WARN | 56 | Emoji in UI | Use a lucide icon or plain text |
| `native-dialog` | ERROR | 50 | Browser alert/confirm/prompt | ConfirmDialog or toast |
| `blur` | WARN | 26 | backdrop-blur (disabled app-wide; leaves translucent panels) | Use opaque bg-elevated / bg-surface |
| `icon-button-label` | ERROR | 25 | Icon-only button without aria-label | aria-label="Edit task" (name the action and the record) |
| `adhoc-z` | WARN | 21 | Ad-hoc z-index | Use the scale variables |
| `button-type` | WARN | 21 | <button> without type (submits surrounding forms) | Add type="button" (or "submit" for the form's submit) |
| `rgb-literal` | ERROR | 19 | rgb()/rgba() colour literal | Use a token, or color-mix(in srgb, var(--token) N%, transparent) |
| `important-mod` | WARN | 14 | Tailwind !important modifier (fighting the cascade) | Fix the component variant instead of forcing |
| `huge-z` | ERROR | 8 | Arbitrary z-index ≥ 1000 | Use the scale: z-[var(--z-popover)], z-[var(--z-modal)] … |
